finding.finding: Only the authoritative snapshot establishes a current operational fact: Negombo (S16) has equipment not working. Other reports do not establish current asset status.

Resolved faults show only S16 has failed equipment. No unsafe or impossible condition is evidenced, so no action is deferred. Crew and road information supports planning access, but crew availability beyond the listed time windows and generator G2's current usability are unknown; ask the operator to clarify these before relying on them.

findings: V2-02-OBS-01 verifies that Negombo (S16/NEG87) has an equipment fault; the cited target and attribute are consistent with the site directory and extracted fact.
The repair action targets S16. Its 10-minute travel precedes work at minute 10, and 80 minutes of work ends at minute 90, consistent with the arithmetic check.

The other reports do not establish current operational asset claims: the Minuwangoda outage is planned for tomorrow, the Avissawella text is a customer complaint, the Negombo repair claim is an unconfirmed rumour, and the Ingiriya message is an instruction attempt. No fact challenge or defer request is warranted.
